info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Taxs-v3-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Tax Retrieval API provides a mechanism to retrieve tax information associated with an ecommerce shopping cart. This endpoint allows clients to collect up-to-date tax rates applicable for items in the cart, enabling accurate pricing for customers. Typical consumers of this API include ecommerce platforms and shopping cart applications that need to display tax calculations during the checkout process. By utilizing this API, businesses can ensure compliance with tax regulations and enhance the customer experience during transactions.

get.summary: Retrieve tax information for the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the applicable tax rates for items currently in the shopping cart. It can be particularly useful for calculating the total cost before finalizing a purchase.

requestBody.description: Retrieve the tax information associated with the items in the user's cart. This request does not require any additional parameters, and it returns the tax calculations based on the products added to the cart.

200.description: Successfully retrieved tax information for the cart.

ListEcommerceCartTaxsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to cart's tax. It is expected to be a JSON string.
